BiblicalUsage: The tower builder's parable turns on this word: which of you, intending to build a tower, does not sit down first and count the cost, whether he has sufficient to finish it? The cost is the whole question of discipleship.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jesus wants us to count the cost before we build, and to build anyway once we have counted it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
